scope: Upstream terms snapshots for external registry endpoints and selected optional checkpoint candidates; not a legal clearance or grant of any model or training rights.

external_models.finding: Hosted commercial-use label and endpoint schema do not establish a license to download, distribute, fine-tune, or rehost FLUX.3 Klein weights.
external_models.training_review: Hosted/API terms, user-upload rules and any training/distillation restrictions require review; no checkpoint license has been verified.

external_models.finding: FLUX.3 Image is a hosted fal endpoint; do not apply FLUX.1 dev, FLUX.2 dev, or FLUX.1 schnell open-weight conditions to this identifier.
external_models.training_review: API/output terms and rehosting/fine-tuning rights must be confirmed for the exact hosted endpoint; no local FLUX.3 weights are bundled.

external_models.finding: Real-ESRGAN source repository's BSD-3-Clause code license is not a verified license for hosted fal inference or every ESRGAN model checkpoint.
external_models.training_review: Exact RealESRGAN_x2plus and alternative pretrained weight redistribution/training conditions must be checked separately; model inference is paid only by opt-in.

external_models.finding: Meta SAM 3 model and code are under a separate SAM License, not Prehnite's MIT; license applicability to the hosted SAM 3.1 variant requires explicit confirmation.
external_models.training_review: Model training, hosted API outputs, trade-controls and redistribution provisions require separately scoped review for this endpoint.

external_models.finding: The BiRefNet adapter is not implemented; this model is a hosted candidate only and has no verified locally distributable weights.
external_models.training_review: Separate code, pretrained checkpoint, training dataset, provider/output and potential redistribution conditions are unresolved.

external_models.finding: ComfyUI application code is GPL-3.0; user workflow graph may load unrelated checkpoints, LoRAs and custom nodes under separate terms.
external_models.training_review: Workflow component provenance and all weight licenses are unknown until the user supplies the exact graph and checkpoint hashes.

external_models.finding: A ComfyUI workflow's GPL software license does not license arbitrary local upscaling models or embedded custom nodes.
external_models.training_review: Local model source, weights, training restrictions and output rights must be reviewed per workflow and checkpoint.

external_models.finding: No segmentation weight is distributed by Prehnite; upstream package and checkpoint terms vary with the workflow.
external_models.training_review: Cannot infer SAM or any other third-party weight redistribution permission from ComfyUI GPL or Prehnite MIT.

external_models.finding: An API-selected judge model is hosted; the software client license does not transfer rights to weights or training data.
external_models.training_review: Commercial service contract, model output restrictions, user media handling and model retention conditions need account-specific review.

candidate_checkpoint_families.name: FLUX.1 [schnell]
candidate_checkpoint_families.training_review: Check exact checkpoint revision, downstream dependencies and output/competitive-training policy. Upstream license label is not a general FLUX-family grant.
candidate_checkpoint_families.redistribution_review: Verify the exact weight revision's included notices before distribution.

candidate_checkpoint_families.name: FLUX.1 [dev]
candidate_checkpoint_families.training_review: Non-commercial model/derivative use; terms restrict some competitive-model training from outputs. Commercial production/model hosting requires a distinct commercial agreement.
candidate_checkpoint_families.redistribution_review: Do not treat model/derivative redistribution as MIT or Apache; license text, notices, restrictions and permitted purposes apply.

candidate_checkpoint_families.name: Meta SAM 3
candidate_checkpoint_families.training_review: SAM License expressly governs models and weights and includes use restrictions; exact checkpoint, training rights and trade-control terms need legal review.
candidate_checkpoint_families.redistribution_review: Redistribution must follow SAM License, including passing along applicable terms; not MIT by virtue of adapter.

candidate_checkpoint_families.name: Real-ESRGAN x2plus
candidate_checkpoint_families.training_review: The BSD-3-Clause source code license alone is insufficient evidence about all pretrained checkpoints, datasets or hosted fal terms.
candidate_checkpoint_families.redistribution_review: Confirm exact named weight download, model metadata and all applicable notice requirements before packaging.
